blocks.text: ROME, Italy — Italy’s Catholic Church received complaints about 356 clergy members who were accused of sexual abuse between 2001 and 2021, according to a long-awaited partial report published on Wednesday. The cases affected 385 victims, with a total of 123 clergy facing proceedings before the Italian courts, said the report by researchers from the University of Bologna and Florence’s Innocenti Institute. The cases yielded 166 recorded judicial decisions, of which 57 resulted in final prison sentences — although the study did not determine whether some clergy received multiple convictions.
